**The death toll from the flash flood in [[Grand Canyon National Park]], [[Arizona]], [[United States]], last Saturday rises to two, while the number of people missing falls from more than 20 to one after [[United States Park Rangers|park rangers]] locate most of those previously unaccounted for.
